classification.difficultyReason: Interpret the shaded border as outer square area minus pool area, then multiply the resulting area by the unit cost.

content.prompt: A square pool of side length 10 metres is to be bordered by a concrete path as shown below. Find the total cost of the concrete if it costs $\$65$ per square metre.

spec.description: Concentric square boundaries with inner side 10 m and outer side 12 m; outer dimension line below the figure. Decorative pool fill omitted; concrete region uses a light standard-palette fill.
spec.mathematics: Outer square side 12 m; inner square side 10 m. Concrete occupies their difference.

answer.worked:
The concrete area is
$$\begin{align*}A&=12^2-10^2\\A&=(12-10)(12+10)\\A&=44\text{ m}^2.\end{align*}$$
The total cost is $44\times\$65=\$2860$.
